hands-free.note: P1-P3 (audio session, hold, ping) and sheet in v0.29.0, queue v0.28.4; iPhone check is Gluck's
hands-free.text: PRIORITY. Hands-free mode (not just voice). (1) BUG: a new message arriving while a reply is being spoken cuts the spoken output off; queue playback instead. (2) Define semantics for messages that arrive while Gluck is recording in hands-free mode (hold, then ping and play after he stops). (3) A short audible ping when a message arrives in hands-free mode. (4) Tap a message: a bottom-sheet action bar (from the chat libraries we borrow from) with play and re-transcribe for any message. (5) No persistence of voice/hands-free mode in browser cache; he turns it on each time. Primitives first: one playback queue and one audio-session state machine reused by play, replay, ping and recording; one message-action sheet reused by future actions. Big impact first, harder items to the back.

hands-free-autoplay.text: BUG: in hands-free mode a newly arrived reply did not auto-play; it must. And with voice off, every message still has play: synthesize on demand when he presses it (no up-front TTS).

ios-audiosession-1795208007.note: play-and-record in v0.28.3 (fig.kelliher.info), session machine v0.29.0; iPhone check is Gluck's
ios-audiosession-1795208007.text: iPhone Safari: 'Could not record: AudioSession category is not compatible with audio capture'. Cause: zanni voce.js engine.unlock sets navigator.audioSession.type = 'playback', which iOS forbids for mic capture. Fix: set 'play-and-record' before getUserMedia (or whenever voice/mic is on), back to 'playback' after; test on iOS Safari that recording and live reply audio both work. Small, Frontend (zanni voce + figchat mic path). Backlog, not urgent (Gluck).
